Agent Name: ScientificPaperAnalysis_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: This step is the critical failure point where the agent fabricates a hypothetical PDF path ('./Hiccup_Fish_Diet.pdf') after failing to locate the actual paper. According to Rule 2, this fabrication of key data (the file path) is the root cause of the subsequent extraction failures. Rule 3 identifies this as the first step where the reasoning path becomes irrecoverable, as all subsequent steps (4-9) are trapped in a loop of attempting to extract from a non-existent file, preventing the correct calculation of the volume.
